Monzo Savings Pot Interest Rates: 2.75% to 4.70% by Plan

brands.evidence: Instant Access Savings: Free 2.80% AER (variable), Extra 3.15%, Perks/Plus/Premium 3.55%, Max and Max Family 3.80%.

client_claims.note: Matches the free plan rate of 2.80% AER variable.

client_claims.text: Extra 3.15%, Perks/Plus/Premium 3.55%, Max and Max Family 3.80% on Instant Access Savings
client_claims.note: Facts only cover the free plan rate.

client_claims.text: Select Access Savings pays 3.45% AER (variable) on free accounts and 3.70% on Perks, Plus, Premium, Max and Max Family, with 2 or fewer withdrawals a year per Pot
client_claims.note: Select Access rates are not covered by the facts.

client_claims.text: A third withdrawal temporarily drops the rate to 2.65% for free accounts, or 3.10% for paid plans
Fixed Rate pots come in 1, 2 and 3 year terms, with rates of up to 5.25% AER (fixed), paid at maturity
client_claims.note: Fixed Rate pots are not covered by the facts.

client_claims.text: Interest is paid on the 1st of the month
A comparison site dated 17 October 2026 listed the free plan at 2.75% AER variable on Instant Access
client_claims.note: This is a third-party figure from a different date. It is not a clear contradiction of the 2.80% rate checked on 21 November 2026.

client_claims.text: The third-party snapshot listed 3.15% on Select Access, 4.70% fixed on a one-year Fixed Rate pot, and paid plans at 3.00%, 3.25% and 3.50% for Instant Access
